title: Körner's Folly

services.name: Bus Tours
services.desc: Once dubbed “The Strangest House in the World,” by Preservation magazine, Körner’s Folly Historic House Museum is the perfect stop for your next mystery tour, or roadside adventure while traveling through beautiful North Carolina. In the heart of the Piedmont Triad, a short distance off Interstate 40, this unique home in Kernersville is a can’t-miss destination for motor coaches! We welcome the opportunity to provide entertaining and educational experiences for private groups up to 50 people. Expert docents will lead the group through all 22 rooms of the house, sharing information about the history, renovations, and furnishings that make Körner’s Folly so unique. Bus and motor coach tours
